Heart rate was 105 beats per min and within normal limits, with mild tachypnea (43 breaths per min) and a rectal temperature of 39.60 ˚C.

claims.text: Referral to a veterinary hospital for advanced diagnostic imaging was scheduled, but the dog experienced sudden death before departure from the shelter. A postmortem necropsy immediately followed and found an extremely enlarged, yellowish, icteric liver with extensive fat damage and abnormal kidneys with nodular lesions. Fatty liver was strongly suspected, and liver and kidney samples were preserved in formalin for histopathology.
